description: Full-text search across French legal sources the Légifrance API serves beyond codes and Cour de cassation case law: the Journal officiel (fond JORF), collective-bargaining agreements (KALI), Conseil d'État / administrative case law (CETAT, the JADE dataset), Constitutional Council decisions (CONSTIT), circulaires (CIRC), company-level agreements (ACCO) and CNIL decisions (CNIL). One fond per call. For consolidated codes/LODA use @pipeworx/france-legi; for Cour de cassation judicial case law use @pipeworx/fr-judilibre.

_apiKey.description: PISTE OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret" for an application subscribed to the "Légifrance Beta" API product. Different from fr-judilibre's KeyId.

date_end.description: Decision date range end, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Only applied for fond CETAT/CONSTIT.

date_start.description: Decision date range start, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Only applied for fond CETAT/CONSTIT.

query.description: Full-text search terms, e.g. "licenciement économique" or "convention collective métallurgie".

name: fr_legifrance_search
